name: Rapier cart: force, mass, inertia and exact sampling time
Zero net force does not stop an already moving cart
Opposite and same-direction forces use the curriculum vectors
Vector and leftward motion report speed magnitude consistently with the live readout
Spring settles to mg/k; force and scale share actual extension
Spring stretch has a transient and agrees with the final gauge
Elementary spring scale: no load, 50, 100 and 175 g
Beam: equal moments stay level; imbalance changes dynamics, not a staged sign angle
A block leaving the beam lands on the stage and is not counted as a supported moment
Fixed-step results are independent of rendering frame rate
Removing a load preserves the initial spring extension and recoils to zero
Cancelling a drag restores the actual world and observation, including the trace
Measurements survive validation and storage without accepting malformed traces
